items.title: Cokernels of maps between the standard presentations are again standard presentations

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in the quasi-compact objects situation the cokernel of a map between modules admitting the standard finite cokernel presentation by direct images j_{U!}O_U along basis members again admits such a presentation. The proof reduces to the cokernel of a map out of a single standard object j_{W!}O_W, whose datum is a section s over W; by the enough-objects hypothesis one chooses a covering of W on which s lifts to a section of the finite direct sum, uses quasi-compactness of W and the refinement lemma to cut the covering to a finite subfamily, and reads off the resulting cokernel presentation (proof lines 5527-5555). H2: the lifting of the section along a covering and the finite cut are the substance, and both steps are written out.
